changes: CodeModeWorkload.swift: each turn now also verifies one codemode execution, exactly 2 faux model requests with no scripted response left, and the fixture tools' own served-call ledger (calls per tool, no rejected request). Every served result is checked against expected.json inputBytes (per tool, per issue number, file_read lines, nestedTotal), along with script bytes and the returned string's resultBytes. The checks are reported in TurnSample, and expected values are unchanged.

CodeModeWorkload.swift: LaunchResult.guest records the quickjs.wasm path that PiCodeMode resolved (getQuickJSWasmURL), with its size and SHA-256. It is read after the last turn and fails the launch on a mismatch with scenario.json's guest pin.
CodeModeWorkload.swift: a Stop turn fails if the fixture served anything besides probe_mark, which also holds when the aborted codemode call returns no result. probe_mark records before signalling.

CodeModeWorkloadCLI.swift: each child keeps its store in a private 0700 directory under TMPDIR and removes it on every path. The driver propagates the first failing child status (1 launch error, 2 verification failure, 128 + signal), rejects --launches below 1 (which used to trap) and invalid --launch, writes sorted-key JSON lines, and never signals or terminates a child.

The children exited normally and were never signalled.
